e.summary: **state-auto-quotes-mcp**（MCP 注册处 **`com.texasautoquotes/insurance`** 等同族记录）**是一个**按美国各州批量登记的「**公开车险均价**」MCP 家族****——**本次实测**：**七个州**（**加州、**佛州、**佐治亚、**内华达、**纽约、**俄克拉何马、**得州**）**逐条记录**版本均为 **1.0.0**、**状态 **active****、**无仓库字段**、**远程端点为** `https://<州>autoquotes.com/mcp`**，**而**登记时间全部落在 **2026-09-04 21:40:57 至 21:41:02 之间****（**⭐ 即**七条**在**约五秒内**被批量登记**）**；**⭐ 描述里**五条逐字带免责**「**Not a quote; we are not licensed here yet.**」**，**而**内华达与得州两条**逐字改为**「**from rates the state publishes**」**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **本次**实际调用**得州端点**，**取回 **8 个工具**（**而**登记处**对它们的描述只有一句话**）**；**② **资格门在收集资料之前**；**③ **卖出的是**去标识**需求记录**，**并写明**不含五位数邮编**；**④ **同意有**范围**（**`contact_consumer` 与 `sell_identity` 两级**）**，**且**每次投递与拒绝都出回执、**并可 **`POST /forget` 撤销**。**⚠️ 本次**只取工具清单，**未提交任何资料、**未调用任何市场工具**。
e.summary_hk: **state-auto-quotes-mcp**（MCP 註冊處 **`com.texasautoquotes/insurance`** 等同族記錄）**是一個**按美國各州批量登記的「**公開車險均價**」MCP 家族****——**本次實測**：**七個州**逐條記錄**版本均為 1.0.0、**狀態 active**、**無倉庫欄位**、**遠端端點為** `https://<州>autoquotes.com/mcp`**，**而**登記時間全部落在 2026-09-04 21:40:57 至 21:41:02 之間****（**⭐ 約五秒內批量登記**）**；**⭐ 描述裡**五條逐字帶免責**「**Not a quote; we are not licensed here yet.**」**，**而**內華達與得州兩條**逐字改為**「**from rates the state publishes**」**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**註冊處裡的東西：調用一次才算數**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **本次實際調用得州端點，**取回 8 個工具**；**② **資格門在收集資料之前**；**③ **賣出的是**去標識**需求記錄**，**且**不含五位數郵編**；**④ **同意有**範圍**（`contact_consumer` 與 `sell_identity` 兩級**）**，**且**每次投遞與拒絕都出回執、**可** `POST /forget` 撤銷**。**⚠️ 本次**只取工具清單，**未提交任何資料、**未調用任何市場工具**。
e.summary_en: The server family state-auto-quotes-mcp, registered as one entry per United States state, **is a batch of motor insurance price servers** whose records were all published within about five seconds of each other, with five of them stating verbatim that the figures are not a quote and that the publisher is not yet licensed in that state, while two carry different wording. **Measured this round**: seven state records, all at version 1.0.0, all active, none with a repository field, each pointing at a remote endpoint on its own domain. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts**, and **four things are worth reading: calling the Texas endpoint returned eight tools, where the registry entry describes the server in a single sentence; the eligibility check comes before any personal details are collected; what is sold is de-identified demand records with the five-digit postcode explicitly excluded; and consent has scopes, with every delivery and refusal receipted and a revocation endpoint**. **Only the tool list was retrieved this round; no information was submitted and no marketplace tool was called.**
e.body:
**state-auto-quotes-mcp**（MCP 注册处 **`com.texasautoquotes/insurance`** 等同族记录）**是一个**按美国各州批量登记的「**公开车险均价**」MCP 家族****——**本次实测**：**七个州逐条为**加州（`com.californiacarquotes/insurance`）、**佛州（`com.flautoquotes/insurance`）、**佐治亚（`com.georgiaautoquotes/insurance`）、**内华达（`com.nevadaautoquotes/insurance`）、**纽约（`com.newyorkautoquotes/insurance`）、**俄克拉何马（`com.oklahomaautoquotes/insurance`）、**得州（`com.texasautoquotes/insurance`**）**；**版本均为 **1.0.0**、**状态 **active**、**`repository` 字段均缺**（**⭐ 即**登记处没有给出源码仓库**）**，**远程端点逐字为** `https://<州>autoquotes.com/mcp`**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均注册处元数据与本次实测调用所得）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 七条记录在**约五秒内**被批量登记**（本次实测）**——**逐条发布时间逐字为** 得州 **2026-09-04T21:40:57Z**、**加州与佛州 **21:40:58Z**、**纽约 **21:41:00Z**、**佐治亚与内华达 **21:41:01Z**、**俄克拉何马 **21:41:02Z**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**登记处的时间戳**本身暴露了**这是一次脚本化的批量发布**——**⭐ 这与本站「**同作者同形近重复**」的判定规则**直接相关**：**当**七条记录**在五秒内出现、**命名同构、**描述同构**时，**按规则**只收族中一条**，**并在条目里说明**这是一个族**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 描述里**免责声明并不一致**（本次实测）**——**五条逐字为**「**«州名»的 published auto insurance averages. **Not a quote; we are not licensed here yet.**」**，**而**内华达与得州两条**逐字改为**「**Auto insurance prices for «州名» drivers, **from rates the state publishes.**」**。**⭐ 本词条**如实并列两种措辞而不替它调和**，**并指出**这正是**批量发布**常见的**细节漂移**（**⭐ 与第 360 轮记下的**「**登记处描述可能滞后或不一致**」同向**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 本次**实际调用**了得州端点，**取回的工具数远超登记处的描述**——**登记处对该服务只有一句话**，**而**握手后 `tools/list` **实测返回 **8 个工具****：`check_eligibility`、`get_quotes`、`pull_requests`、`data_use_terms`、`request_agent_contact`、`register_agency`、`market_data`、`agency_status`**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**登记处里一句话的东西**，**调用一次之后**是**一条完整的业务闭环**——**⭐ 而**这与第 360／361 轮反复出现的**「**登记 ≠ 可用 ≠ 完整**」同一主题**：**要判断一个 MCP 服务做什么**，**必须**调用它的工具清单**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 而它其实是一条**带同意范围的线索市场****——**实测工具描述逐字为**：**① **资格门**「**Check whether we can return quotes for a state **before any personal details are collected**. **Call this first.** Returns the states we are licensed in, what we can do in each, and how many licensed agents can take a request there.**」**；**② **报价**「**Return indicative auto insurance prices from multiple carriers, **where this entity is licensed to show them**. **Takes rating facts only — no name, phone, email, SSN or licence number is required for an indicative price.** Where we are not licensed to show prices, the request is still registered and **a quote_id returned** so licensed agents can quote it. **If facts are missing the server asks for exactly what it needs and nothing more.**」**；**③ **同意与转交**「**Needs the quote_id **」**——**逐字續**「**, the consumer的 name and phone, and **the consumer的 explicit consent to be contacted** **」**——**逐字續**「** **Under scope `contact_consumer` up to 4 licensed agents receive the request and contact details; `sell_identity` additionally permits sharing with marketing partners.** **Nothing leaves without the consent. Every delivery and refusal is receipted, and `POST /forget` revokes.**」**；**④ **数据用途条款**「**What happens to anything you send us: who receives it, for what purpose, how long it is kept, how your human revokes it, and **the exact consent wording to present before `request_agent_contact`**. **Machine readable so you can evaluate the exchange before making it.**」**；**⑤ **卖出的一侧**「**Buy provenance-qualified, de-identified demand records **」**——**逐字續**「** only requests backed by a **cryptographically or IP-verified agent, or a phone-verified consumer outcome**. **User-agent claims, legacy rows, probes and impostors are quarantined and unavailable for sale.** **」**——**逐字續**「** **Never a name, phone, email, date of birth or five-digit ZIP.**」**；**⑥ **机构侧**「**register the agency to receive consented consumer requests in its states. Needs the agency name, the producer NPN（National Producer Number）and its state **」**——**逐字續**「** **The licensed contact confirms by a link sent to their email; nothing is delivered before that.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组值得抄的地方有**三处**：**（**a**）**同意**不是**一句提示**，**而是**两个具名范围**（**`contact_consumer` 与 **`sell_identity`**）**，**而**且**由人来给**；**（**b**）**每次投递与拒绝都出**回执**，**且**撤销有专门端点**；**（**c**）**卖出的数据**明确**去掉姓名、**电话、**邮箱、**出生日期与五位数邮编**，**并**把**未验证的 Agent**、**探针与冒充者**列为**隔离不售****。**⚠️ 本词条如实指出**：**⭐ 这句话**恰好覆盖本次的行为**——**本次正是一次**探针**，**⭐ 而**按服务自述，**探针数据**不会进入可售数据集**；**⭐ 本词条**据此强调**：**本次**未调用** `get_quotes`、**`request_agent_contact`、**`market_data` 或 `pull_requests` **中的任何一个**，**也**未提交任何姓名、**电话或地址**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insuranceoracle]]、**[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、**[[property-hazard-mcp]]、**[[root-insurance-mcp]]、**[[bima-mcp]]、**[[claims-triage-mcp]] 覆盖面向 Agent 的保险服务**，**[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、**[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]] 覆盖车险报价与业务规则**，**[[insurance-fairness-ldp]]、**[[insurance-governance]] 覆盖数据治理与公平性**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一条**按州批量登记的车险线索市场：**先查牌照再收资料 ＋ **同意分两个具名范围 ＋ **投递与拒绝都出回执并可撤销 ＋ **卖出数据去掉直接标识**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[insuranceoracle]]、[[insurance-governance]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **收集任何资料之前**先查**能不能服务**；**② **同意要写成**具名范围**，**而**不是**一个布尔量**；**③ **投递与拒绝**都留回执**，**并**提供**撤销入口**；**④ **对外提供的记录**去掉**直接标识**（**含**五位数邮编**）**；**⑤ **批量发布的东西**在登记处会留下**时间戳痕迹**，**识别同一族并不难**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做了一次 MCP 握手与一次工具清单调用**（**未调用** `get_quotes`／`request_agent_contact`／`market_data`／`pull_requests`／`register_agency` **中的任何一个、**未提交任何姓名、**电话、**地址或同意**），**故**不主张**其报价质量、**线索真实性、**回执机制或**撤销机制的实际行为**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只调用得州一个端点**（**⭐ 其余六州**按同族处理、**未逐个调用**）**——**⚠️ 故**「**八个工具在同族各州是否一致**」**本次**未核实**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `pull_requests` **所述** x402 **与 **402 状态**的实际返回**；**也未核实** `market_data` **的定价、**最小起订量与**免费样本**（**⭐ 描述称**样本与模式在 `/data.json`**，**本次**未访问**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `register_agency` **所需的 **NPN**（**全国生产者编号**）**如何被验证**，**也未核实**「**首个机构在本州免费**」**这一创始期安排的具体条款**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**牌照声明**是否属实**（**⭐ 描述称**返回「**我们已获牌的州**」**）**，**也未核实其**运营主体**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**该服务**面向消费者时的**信息披露**与**同意界面**（**⭐ 本次**只看到机器可读条款的工具**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**七条记录发布于 **2026-09-04**（**比解冻窗口起点早两天**）**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**按州批量登记的车险线索市场：**资格门前置 ＋ **同意分范围 ＋ **回执与撤销 ＋ **卖出数据去标识**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该服务**面向的是**线索转交**，**其「**均价**」不是报价**（**⭐ 服务自己就这么写**）**，**不得**当作任何核保或定价依据**。

Every delivery and refusal is receipted, and `POST /forget` revokes.**」**；**④ 資料用途條款**「**the exact consent wording to present before `request_agent_contact`. Machine readable so you can evaluate the exchange before making it.**」**；**⑤ 賣出的一側**「**Buy provenance-qualified, de-identified demand records **」**——**逐字續**「** cryptographically or IP-verified agent, or a phone-verified consumer outcome. User-agent claims, legacy rows, probes and impostors are quarantined and unavailable for sale.** **」**——**逐字續**「** **Never a name, phone, email, date of birth or five-digit ZIP.**」**；**⑥ 機構側**「**The licensed contact confirms by a link sent to their email; nothing is delivered before that.**」**。**⭐ 三處值得抄**：**（**a**）同意**不是一個布林量**，**而是**兩個具名範圍**；**（**b**）每次投遞與拒絕都出**回執**，**且**撤銷有專門端點**；**（**c**）賣出的資料**去掉姓名、**電話、**郵箱、**出生日期與五位數郵編**，**並**把**未驗證的 Agent、**探針與冒充者**列為**隔離不售****。**⚠️ 如實指出**：**這句話**恰好覆蓋本次的行為**——**本次正是一次**探針**，**而**按服務自述，**探針資料**不會進入可售資料集**；**⭐ 本次**未調用** `get_quotes`／`request_agent_contact`／`market_data`／`pull_requests` **任何一個**，**也未提交任何姓名、**電話或地址**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insuranceoracle]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[property-hazard-mcp]]、[[root-insurance-mcp]]、[[bima-mcp]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]]、[[insurance-fairness-ldp]]、[[insurance-governance]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**按州批量登記的車險線索市場：先查牌照再收資料＋同意分兩個具名範圍＋投遞與拒絕都出回執並可撤銷＋賣出資料去掉直接標識**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[insuranceoracle]]、[[insurance-governance]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 五點最值得借鑑**：**① **收集任何資料之前**先查**能不能服務**；**② **同意寫成**具名範圍**；**③ **投遞與拒絕**都留回執並提供撤銷入口**；**④ **對外提供的記錄**去掉**直接標識**；**⑤ **批量發布的東西**在登記處會留下**時間戳痕跡****。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做一次 MCP 握手與一次工具清單調用**（**未調用** `get_quotes`／`request_agent_contact`／`market_data`／`pull_requests`／`register_agency`、**未提交任何姓名、**電話、**地址或同意**），**不主張**其報價質量、**線索真實性、**回執或**撤銷機制的實際行為**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只調用得州一個端點**（**其餘六州按同族處理、**未逐個調用**）——**⚠️ 故**「**八個工具在同族各州是否一致**」**本次未核實**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** x402 **與** 402 狀態**的實際返回**；**未核實** `market_data` **的定價、**最小起訂量與免費樣本**（**未訪問** `/data.json`**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** NPN（**全國生產者編號**）**如何被驗證**，**未核實**「**首個機構在本州免費**」**的具體條款**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其**牌照聲明**是否屬實**，**未核實其運營主體**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**其**面向消費者時的信息披露與同意界面**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**七條記錄發布於 2026-09-04**（**比窗口起點早兩天**）**——**本條的缺口是**「**按州批量登記的車險線索市場：資格門前置＋同意分範圍＋回執與撤銷＋賣出資料去標識**」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該服務**面向線索轉交**，**其「**均價**」不是報價**，**不得**當作任何核保或定價依據**。

e.body_en:
The server family state-auto-quotes-mcp, registered as one record per United States state, **is a batch of motor insurance price servers** whose seven measured records were all published between the fifty-seventh second of one minute and the second second of the next on a single day in early September, at identical version, all active, and none with a repository field, each pointing at a remote endpoint on its own domain. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata and the call made this round**: **first, seven records were published within about five seconds of each other**, which this entry notes exposes a scripted batch publication and is directly relevant to the standing rule about near-duplicate siblings from one author, under which only one member of a family is collected and the family is described. **Second, the disclaimer wording inside the family is not uniform**: five records state verbatim that the figures are published averages and that this is not a quote because the publisher is not licensed in that state yet, while two records instead say the prices come from rates the state publishes. **This entry records both wordings side by side without reconciling them, as an instance of the detail drift that batch publication tends to produce.** **Third, calling the Texas endpoint returned far more than the registry entry describes**: the registry describes the server in one sentence, while an MCP handshake followed by a tool list returned **eight tools**, covering eligibility, indicative quotes, pulling routed records, data-use terms, requesting agent contact, registering an agency, buying de-identified demand data, and checking agency status. **A single sentence in a registry can be a complete business loop once called, which is why the tool list, not the registry description, is what tells you what a server does.** **Fourth, what the server actually is, is a lead marketplace with consent scopes**: verbatim, eligibility is checked before any personal details are collected, and the tool says to call it first, returning the states the publisher is licensed in and how many licensed agents can take a request there; indicative prices take rating facts only, with no name, phone, email, social security number or licence number required, and where the publisher is not licensed to show prices the request is still registered and a quote identifier is returned so licensed agents can quote it, with the server asking for exactly what it needs and nothing more when facts are missing; connecting a consumer requires the quote identifier, a name and a phone number, and the consumer explicit consent, under a scope where up to four licensed agents receive the request and details or a wider scope that additionally permits sharing with marketing partners, with the statement that nothing leaves without consent, that every delivery and refusal is receipted, and that a forget endpoint revokes; a data-use-terms tool returns who receives anything sent, for what purpose, how long it is kept, how the human revokes it, and the exact consent wording to present, machine readable so the exchange can be evaluated before it is made; the sell side covers provenance-qualified, de-identified demand records backed only by a cryptographically or IP-verified agent or a phone-verified consumer outcome, with user-agent claims, legacy rows, probes and impostors quarantined and unavailable for sale, and with names, phone numbers, emails, dates of birth and five-digit postcodes never included; and the agency side requires the agency name, the producer national number and the appointed states, with the licensed contact confirming by a link sent to their email and nothing delivered before that. **Three of those are worth copying: consent is not a boolean but two named scopes; every delivery and refusal is receipted and revocation has its own endpoint; and the sold data drops direct identifiers while unverified agents, probes and impostors are quarantined from sale.** **This entry notes plainly that the quarantine sentence covers exactly what this round did, since this round was a probe, and therefore states that none of the quote, contact, market-data or pull tools was called and that no name, phone number or address was submitted.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agent-facing insurance services, motor insurance quoting and business rules, and data governance and fairness, **while this entry supplies a per-state batch of motor insurance lead-marketplace servers that gate on licensing before collecting anything, split consent into named scopes, receipt every delivery and refusal while offering revocation, and drop direct identifiers from what is sold. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled insurance oracle and the pooled insurance governance entries**; **five practices transfer directly: check whether you may serve before collecting anything; write consent as named scopes rather than a boolean; receipt every delivery and refusal and expose a revocation path; strip direct identifiers from anything offered outward; and recognise that batch-published registry entries leave timestamp traces that make family membership easy to detect**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, only one MCP handshake and one tool-list call were made**, with none of the quote, contact, market-data, pull or agency-registration tools called and no name, phone number, address or consent submitted, **so no claim is made about quote quality, lead authenticity, or the actual behaviour of the receipt and revocation mechanisms**. **Second, only the Texas endpoint was called**, the other six being treated as family members without individual calls, **so whether the eight tools are identical across the family was not verified**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the actual response for a payment-required state was not verified, nor were the pricing, minimum purchase or free sample of the market-data tool**, the described sample file not having been visited. **Fourth, how a producer national number is validated was not verified, nor were the terms of the free founding period for the first agencies in a state. Fifth, whether the licensing claims are accurate was not verified, nor was the operating entity identified. Sixth, the consumer-facing disclosure and consent interface was not verified**, only the machine-readable terms tool having been seen. **Seventh, on the window: the seven records were published two days before the thaw window opened, and following the project convention of naming the gap, the gap here is that a per-state batch of motor insurance lead-marketplace servers with a licensing gate, scoped consent, receipts and revocation, and de-identified sale data had no counterpart in the pool. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the service is about lead handoff, that its published averages are not a quote as the service itself says, and that they must not be used as a basis for underwriting or pricing.**
